title: Bridge for a Pending Independent Review, Formulary Benefit Expedited Approvals
content:
Under the Formulary Benefit, a review bridge is added to the exigency period of an expedited exception approval while an independent review of an earlier denial of the drug is pending. The bridge keeps coverage from lapsing before the reviewer decides. The member's exception history for the drug is read: external review requests, external review decisions, and the priority on each request.

**Pending.** A review is pending when the records carry more external review requests for the drug than external review decisions.

| Review pending | Priority of the latest external review request for the drug | Bridge added |
|---|---|---|
| yes | expedited | **2** days |
| yes | standard | **4** days |
| no | any | none |

The bridge is added to the exigency period before the floor of one day is applied.

*Hypothetical histories.*
- One external review request (standard), no decision yet: 4 days.
- Two requests and one decision, latest request expedited: 2 days.
- One request and one decision: nothing is pending, and no bridge is added.
